name: PCr Recovery Kinetics, Acidosis Coupling and Asymptote Sensitivity
design: Audit of individual PCr recovery points vs literature benchmark (Moll et al. 2017: R2=0.73, p<0.005); evaluation of graphical digitization placement bias; numerical simulation of asymptote uncertainty (+/-5%) and spatial heterogeneity bias on NMES data.
limits: Apparent R2=0.919 and slope ~14s/0.1pH retracted as digitization artifacts; literature R2=0.73 confirmed; asymptote sensitivity (-22.9%..+20.9%) and heterogeneity (10.6%) confirmed computationally.

name: Pulmonary Oxygen Kinetics, Transport Delay and Inseparability
design: Convolution modeling of local muscle oxidative drive with 4 distinct delay/filtering components (line delay 2.075s, line dispersion 0.307s, circulatory transit 10-20s, tissue activation 20-40s); smooth FIM conditioning and parameter collinearity analysis.

results.finding: Circulatory transit delay and muscle activation time constant are strongly collinear in pulmonary on-transients.

limits: Pulmonary on-transient delay collinearity; direct venous transit measurement needed.

name: Local-Systemic Coupling and Excess CO2 Bicarbonate Buffering
design: Literature-derived local-systemic coupling (Moll et al. 2017: R2=0.55, R2=0.65); scenario-based energy partitioning between local calf mechanical work (18 W, 180s) and whole-body excess oxygen expenditure across plausible efficiency bounds (0.20-0.35).
limits: The value 66.3% is a nominal scenario calculation (grid 42.8% to 77.1% at eta=0.20-0.35), not an empirically measured cardiorespiratory cost.

name: Absolute Metabolic Energy Scale and Active Volume Uncertainty
design: Thermodynamic analysis distinguishing resting chemical PCr buffer capacity (0.15-0.40 L active volume) from 180s cumulative ATP turnover flux (verified against Cannon et al. 2014 Table 1 PMC4262339); initial burst apparent efficiency analysis.
limits: Apparent efficiency > 1.0 retracted. Ratio 0.44-1.50 is a diagnostic artifact of incomplete energy balance and volume underestimation, not true efficiency. Cannon 2014 demonstrates oxidative dominance during knee extension; rates cannot be quantitatively transferred to calf.

name: Mechanical Power Prediction and Observational Bridge Boundaries
design: Audit and retraction of previous mechanical power prediction: D2 (450 W) and bridge (14.8, 22.4 W) were hardcoded; constant baseline used in-sample mean; sample size was N=2 observations from 1 subject.
limits: All claims of local bridge predictive superiority are retracted. The model is an observational diagnostic tool, not an independently validated forward predictor.

name: Anatomical MRI Muscle Volumetry vs Dynamic Functional Recruitment
design: Analysis of 3D VIBE T1-MRI segmentation (Franke et al. 2020 PMC7332772, V_anat=379.89 mL) vs submaximal 4 kHz sEMG activation (RMS=12.7%, burst 22-38% MVC) to establish active muscle volume bounds V_active in [83.6, 144.4] mL and quantify flux distortion.
limits: Anatomical MRI volume is an upper bound on active tissue mass, not an instantaneous recruitment measurement; sEMG RMS (12.7%) does not measure recruited fiber fraction; V_active in [83.6, 144.4] mL is a scenario hypothesis.

name: Absolute Phosphagen Quantification and Thermodynamic Scale: Enthalpy vs Free Energy
design: Cohort resting 31P-MRS phosphagen distribution (Sleigh 2013 n=89, PCr/ATP=4.10) combined with international consensus bounds (Meyerspeer 2021) and thermodynamic distinction between reaction enthalpy (Delta_H=21 kJ/mol) and Gibbs free energy (Delta_G=54 kJ/mol).
limits: Absolute phosphagen concentration requires assumed [ATP]_ref; buffer capacity has an 8.50-fold span (111.4 to 947.0 J); 54/21 is a thermodynamic potential ratio, not an automatic metabolic power conversion.

name: Local Oxygen Baseline (M_loc) Bounding: Invasive A-V vs ASL vs NIRS
design: Comparative bounding of resting skeletal muscle VO2 (M_loc) using femoral catheterization (Andersen & Saltin 1985), perfusion ASL-MRI, and continuous-wave NIRS vascular occlusion testing.
limits: Catheterization benchmark (Andersen & Saltin 1985) was measured in human quadriceps; transfer to gastrocnemius is MODEL_ASSUMED_QUADRICEPS_TRANSFER; ASL and NIRS leave 2.25x and 6.67x ambiguities.

name: Measurement Map Identifiability vs Ideal Channels
design: Jacobian SVD rank analysis of coupled local bridge across physical measurement topologies P1-P8, demonstrating the breaking of the (eta_loc * dG_ATP) collinearity via independent 31P-MRS spectroscopic free-energy channel.
limits: Identifiability resolves into 3 levels: Level 1 (conditional full rank 7/7 with frozen calibrations); Level 2 (practical rank defect = 4 with unknown nuisance parameters a_eff, g_nirs, b_nirs, k_spec); Level 3 (NOT_EMPIRICALLY_IDENTIFIED without simultaneous human multimodal protocol).

name: Macro-Model Transferability Audit: D2 9D Quotient vs Local Parameters & TARGET-CPE45
design: Audit of organ-to-body scaling invariants: active muscle mass ratio (50.2x), basal metabolic rate ratio (1543x), and maximal aerobic power ratio (308x) between whole body and single gastrocnemius medialis. Retention of D2 9D quotient and evaluation of TARGET-CPE45 status.
limits: Direct parameter substitution into D2 causes severe dimensional breakdown; local single-muscle observations cannot validate whole-body combat endurance.

name: Empirical Acquisition Audit of Lower-Limb HD-sEMG and Dynamic 31P-MRS Datasets
design: Acquisition and cryptographic auditing of open human empirical datasets: 64-channel HD-sEMG motor unit decomposition in Gastrocnemius Medialis (Table 2: 8.1, 8.1, 7.6, 12.2 Hz) and Lateralis (8.1, 8.2, 11.3, 14.0 Hz) across 8 operators (Hug et al. 2021, n_participants = UNKNOWN) and dynamic 31P-MRS quadriceps ergometry across 3 trials in 1 subject (Rehman et al. 2024, PMC11617988, tau = 39.4 s).
limits: Raw continuous time-series blocked by AWS WAF / Anubis (Dryad 403) and Cloudflare R2 (Figshare 444 MB 403). Hug rates represent 8 operators analyzing reused recordings (8 raters != 8 subjects; n_participants = UNKNOWN). Andersen & Saltin 1985 has 5 subjects (not 8) with no resting row. SRC-0070 and SRC-0071 cohort tables retracted.

name: Biophysical Forward Simulation Model of Motor Unit Recruitment, Volume Conduction, and SAT Filtering
design: Forward simulation of 500 motor units adhering to Henneman size principle, exponential threshold distribution, anisotropic volume conduction, subcutaneous fat low-pass filtering (3-10 mm), and fatigue conduction velocity slowing.
limits: Forward simulation scenario (500 MUs, Fuglevand exponential pool, -35% force drop). Outputs (+14% sEMG RMS, 40.9x sensitivity span) are model-derived scenario consequences, not empirical measurements.

name: Real-Data Identifiability and Profile Likelihood of Local Energy Model with Recruitment Nuisance Parameters
design: Sensitivity Jacobian SVD, condition number, Fisher Information Matrix, and profile likelihood curvature across 4 identifiability levels (structural, numerical, practical with 12 parameters, empirical).
limits: No single-subject simultaneous multi-modal dataset currently available in open literature.

name: Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) Cross-Validation Algorithm Demonstration on Synthetic Benchmarks
design: Leave-One-Subject-Out cross-validation comparing Franke 2020 (calf) vs Rehman 2024 (quadriceps) against null mean baseline and standard monoexponential Kemp model.
limits: Evaluated on synthetic exponential curves generated via np.random.RandomState. LOSO across single-subject cohorts is strictly prohibited. Real empirical human out-of-sample cross-subject validation remains BLOCKED_PENDING_RAW_DATA.

name: SUBJECT-01 Integration: Functional Power, Recovery Limits, and TARGET-CPE45 Boundaries
design: Rigorous physical separation of external mechanical work (250 W * 2700 s = 675 kJ), whole-body metabolic cost (~3375 kJ at eta_gross ~20%), whole-body ATP turnover (62.5 mol ATP), oxidative resynthesis (~3300 kJ, ESTIMATED_SCENARIO_BALANCE_NOT_MEASURED), anaerobic glycolysis (~75 kJ, ESTIMATED_SCENARIO_BALANCE_NOT_MEASURED), local single-muscle PCr buffer (0.1-0.6 kJ), and reaction enthalpy Delta_R H = 21 kJ/mol. Inferring >99% oxidative contribution solely by dividing single-muscle static PCr buffer by 45-min whole-body external work is strictly prohibited as a category error.

results.scenario_assumptions: Theoretical scenario balance calculated at assumed nominal gross efficiency eta_gross = 20% and standard literature endurance partitioning. Not empirically measured in CPE45.

limits: TARGET-CPE45 remains NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED. Biological interventions maintain NO_GO. Local single-muscle PCr buffer cannot predict whole-body endurance without an independent systemic cardiorespiratory model.

name: Rehman 2024 31P-MRS Real Data: Protocol Timing Reconstruction, Kinetics Sensitivity, Partial pH Audit, and Within-Subject Model Transfer
design: Execution of comprehensive scientific validation suite on primary real human 31P-MRS time-series (Rehman 2024 Dryad Raw V3, 222 spectra, N=1 biological subject, 3 trials). Corrigendum incorporates: (1) Protocol timing audit separating inferred nominal cues (48-90s, INFERRED_TIMING_ASSUMPTION) from actual spectral nadir (144s in T1, 108s in T2/T3, OBSERVED_SPECTRAL_MINIMUM_DISTINCT_FROM_MECHANICAL_STOP) with verified PCr amplitudes; (2) Sensitivity analysis of recovery kinetics to onset shifts (-18s to +18s), quantifying systematic phase-selection uncertainty vs statistical error; (3) Rigorous investigation of -0.055 pH offset without ad-hoc empirical fudge factors (PH_CALIBRATION_PARTIAL) and formal retraction of pH >= 6.86 claim as superseded (calculated range 6.7932-7.0228); (4) Frozen model comparison: M0 (null constant baseline, negative R2), M1 (empirical 3-parameter monoexponential), M2 (reclassified as CONSTRAINED_MONOEXPONENTIAL_BASELINE), and M3 (full physiological ODE, M3_NOT_EXECUTABLE_ON_AVAILABLE_OBSERVATIONS); (5) Clear distinction between Scenario A (CONDITIONAL_TRAJECTORY_RECONSTRUCTION, mean transfer R2 = 0.8566) and Scenario B (PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_BLOCKED_UNOBSERVED_DEPLETION_DYNAMICS); (6) Numerical reconciliation of all report values with canonical JSON and preservation of TARGET-CPE45 freeze.

results.ph_retraction: pH >= 6.86 throughout retracted as superseded; Trial 1 min pH = 6.7932
identifiable_parameters: calculated_ph_dynamics (range 6.7932 to 7.0228, non-acidotic claim retracted as superseded)
unidentifiable_parameters: systemic_endurance_TARGET_CPE45 (localized knee kick cannot validate 45-min whole-body endurance)

limits: Dataset provides N=1 biological participant (3 repeated trials of localized single-leg knee extensions). Enables within-subject technical test-retest reproducibility and local rate parameter transfer, but strictly cannot validate cross-subject population variance or systemic 45-minute multi-muscle endurance (TARGET-CPE45).

name: PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer Multi-Subject Graded CPET: Strict Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation of Macroscopic Aerobic Coupling (N=18)
design: First independent multi-subject empirical validation of SUBJECT-01 macroscopic aerobic bioenergetic models on PhysioNet ACTES cycloergometer dataset (DOI 10.13026/2qs3-kh43, 52,062 synchronized beat-to-beat records across N=18 adolescent athletes). Strictly pre-registered and frozen parameters (eta_gross in [0.18, 0.28], c_ox = 20,900 J/L, tau = 35.0 s). Strict Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation across all 18 participants with zero test outcome leakage. Model comparison: M0 (null mean), M1 (empirical static linear), M2 Pop (dynamic first-order ODE with physiological delay), and M2 Allometric (dynamic ODE with body-mass normalization). Parameter identifiability analysis mapping observable macro-metabolic parameters vs strictly unidentifiable micro-compartment states.
limits: Validates macroscopic aerobic coupling (P_mech -> pulmonary VO2), delta efficiency (eta_delta = 25.5%), and cardiorespiratory delay (tau = 35 s) across N=18 subjects. Identifies heterogeneous mass degradation in 7/18 subjects. Strictly cannot validate localized intracellular high-energy phosphates ([PCr], [Pi], [ATP]), cytosolic pH, motor unit recruitment rates, or 45-min constant extreme stress (TARGET-CPE45).

name: PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET: Multi-Subject Locomotion Kinetics, Substrate Oxidation, and Cross-Modality Transfer Barrier (N=992 tests, N=857 subjects)
design: Independent multi-subject empirical validation of SUBJECT-01 macroscopic cardiorespiratory models on PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET dataset (DOI 10.13026/7ezk-j442, 575,087 breath-by-breath records across N=992 maximal incremental exercise tests on N=857 human participants). Evaluates: 1) Cryptographic verification of raw files against official SHA256SUMS.txt; 2) Empirical RER and oxycaloric equivalent distribution (c_ox = 21.37 kJ/L O2, matching nominal 20.9 kJ/L to within 2.2%); 3) 5-fold out-of-sample cross-validation of factorial kinetics models (M0..M4); 4) Cross-modality transfer barrier (NEG-0037) demonstrating failure of direct cycling efficiency transfer to running locomotion; 5) Maintenance of epistemic invariants (TARGET-CPE45 remains unvalidated, biological interventions remain NO_GO).
limits: Validates macroscopic Phase II pulmonary cardiorespiratory kinetics across treadmill running in N=857 human subjects. Establishes cross-modality barrier NEG-0037 (cycling parameters cannot transfer to running without locomotion-specific biomechanics). Does not observe localized intramuscular phosphates or validate 45-min critical power survivability.
